summary: Updated out-of-band alpha for CEE 1.2.0 build 132, based on WWPG 0.2.11. Experimental testing release; full headless and graphical acceptance have not been completed for this exact build.
changes: Restores electrocution from live CEE wires while preserving insulation and dielectric protection.
Fixes wire-contact-related unavailable readings and restores stock CEE transformer node voltages.
Includes the 0.2.11 fixes and retains the earlier wire preview and moving-sublevel wiring fixes.
installation: Use Minecraft 1.21.1, Java 21, NeoForge 21.1.262, Create 6.0.10, CEE 1.21.1-1.2.0-132, Power Grid 0.6.2 and Architectury 13.0.12. Replace your WWPG jar on client and server. Set PG multiTicks to 16. Test a copy of your world. Both solvers passed 40 focused server checks each; no new graphical acceptance was run. Bundled example worlds are unchanged historical exports, not retested on this alpha.
optional_installation: The combined Stationary Yard requires CC:Tweaked 1.120.2 and Pinout 0.2.1. Example worlds retain their original .5 version labels; test copies only.
